description: Inspect the explicitly chosen site and store a promotion plan with its preview/production URLs and current production deployment. No content changes. At apply time preview is renamed into production, old production is archived for background deletion, and preview is reset to empty. Preview has no separate database and shares the main site’s database and storage quota. Promotion is blocked if production has wp-config.php and preview does not; force must be explicitly selected when planning to bypass this check. Requires hosting.sitesRead; applying also requires hosting.deploy.

force.description: Explicitly bypass the missing preview wp-config.php promotion guard

name: plan_promote
title: Plan preview promotion to production
